newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahraini insurer to raise capital to $25 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bahraini insurer to raise capital to $25 mln.

text.p: A Bahraini insurance company plans to raise its paid-in capital to $25 million from $7 million by offering shares to shareholders.

Arab International Insurance Company (AIIC) said on Monday it would offer 70.6 million shares worth $17.65 million to existing shareholders from June 22 for two weeks. The extra funds from subscription would go to reserves, an AIIC statement said.
The shares, which will be offered in Bahrain and Kuwait, will be priced at 25 U.S. cents plus half a U.S. cent premium.
Established in 1981 as an offshore insurance company based in Bahrain, AIIC's activities include insurance and reinsurance.
AIIC posted a $41,512 net profit in 1996, sharply down from $137,151 in 1995 and $344,582 in 1994, according to figures issued by the company.
